title: Scaling Vision Transformers to Gigapixel Images via Hierarchical Self-Supervised Learning
population_or_data: Cancer pretraining and slide-level subtyping/survival benchmarks.
main_findings: HIPT learns representations across cell, patch and larger tissue contexts.
limitations: Hierarchical spatial context does not equal fusion of independently extracted magnifications.
Review covers the cited pages; quantitative tables require further source verification.
does_not_establish: No proven optimal magnification or benefit for cardiac biopsies.
relevance_to_project: Compare spatial hierarchy with current magnification late fusion.
